arguments.message:
Hi there! To locate last month’s invoice, go to **Settings → Billing → Invoices**. The page shows a table of all invoices, ordered by billing date with the most recent at the top. The summary card at the top only displays the current month’s invoice; scroll down to the invoices table to find earlier months. Each row has a link to download the PDF, which you can forward for your expense report.

If you don’t see the month you need, it’s possible that no invoice was generated for that period (for example, if the month was fully covered by a credit). In that case there won’t be a PDF to download.

Let me know if you need any more help!
